examples.chinese: 我爸爸喜歡吃飯，我媽媽喜歡吃麵。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba xǐhuān chī fàn, wǒ māma xǐhuān chī miàn.
examples.english: My dad likes to eat rice, my mom likes to eat noodles.

examples.chinese: 太好了！我最愛吃牛肉麵。他們也賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zuì ài chī niúròu miàn. Tāmen yě mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: That is awesome! Beef noodles is my favorite. Do they sell drinks as well?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: A：你想點什麼？ B：我想點一碗牛肉麵。

examples.chinese: 小姐，我們要點兩碗牛肉麵和兩杯茶。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒmen yào diǎn liǎng wǎn niúròu miàn hé liǎng bēi chá.
examples.english: Miss, we would like to order two bowls of beef noodles and two cups of tea.

examples.chinese: 他在房間外面做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān wàimiàn zuò shénme?
examples.english: What is he doing outside of the room?

examples.chinese: 你的筆在那本書上面。

examples.english: Your pen is on top of the book.

examples.chinese: 客廳裡面有兩張沙發。
examples.pinyin: Kètīng lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng zhāng shāfā.
examples.english: There are two sofas in the living room.

examples.chinese: 你的錢包在那件衣服下面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de qiánbāo zài nà jiàn yīfu xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Your wallet is under that piece of clothing.

examples.chinese: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
examples.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

examples.chinese: 窗戶前面有很多花，很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Chuānghù qiánmiàn yǒu hěn duō huā, hěn piàoliàng.
examples.english: There are many flowers in front of the window. It’s very beautiful.

examples.chinese: 弟弟在門後面。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zài mén hòumiàn.
examples.english: My younger brother is behind the door.

examples.chinese: 弟弟在門的後面。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zài mén de hòumiàn.
examples.english: The younger brother is behind the door.

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。

examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友在那家旅館前面等我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu zài nà jiā lǚguǎn qiánmiàn děng wǒ.
examples.english: My friend is waiting for me in front of that hotel.

examples.chinese: 那家咖啡廳在郵局對面。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēitīng zài yóujú duìmiàn.
examples.english: That coffee shop is across from the post office.

examples.chinese: 你這個週末有空嗎？ 我想跟你見面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège zhōumò yǒu kòng ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn.
examples.english: Are you free this weekend? I want to meet with you.

examples.chinese: 他打算坐捷運去跟朋友見面。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn zuò jiéyùn qù gēn péngyǒu jiànmiàn.
examples.english: He plans to take the MRT to meet a friend.

examples.chinese: 那家有名的麵包店賣很多種麵包，都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǒumíng de miànbāo diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng miànbāo, dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: That famous bakery sells many kinds of bread; all are delicious.

examples.chinese: 他們在裡面談話，你現在不要進去。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài lǐmiàn tánhuà, nǐ xiànzài búyào jìnqù.
examples.english: They are talking inside; don't go in now.

examples.chinese: 外面很冷，請進來吧！
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng, qǐng jìnlái ba!
examples.english: It's very cold outside; please come in!

examples.chinese: 我們要過馬路，到對面去坐公車。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào guò mǎlù, dào duìmiàn qù zuò gōngchē.
examples.english: We need to cross the road to go to the opposite side to take the bus.

examples.chinese: 我買了三個麵包，吃了兩個了，最後一個明天再吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le sān gè miànbāo, chī le liǎng gè le, zuìhòu yī gè míngtiān zài chī.
examples.english: I bought three breads, I have eaten two, I will eat the last one tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 上次我們吃牛肉麵，這次也吃牛肉麵，下次吃別的吧。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì wǒmen chī niúròumiàn, zhè cì yě chī niúròumiàn, xià cì chī bié de ba.
examples.english: Last time we ate beef noodles, this time we're also eating beef noodles; next time let's eat something else.

examples.chinese: 捷運站的洗手間外面有很多人在排隊，你要去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhàn de xǐshǒujiān wàimiàn yǒu hěn duō rén zài páiduì, nǐ yào qù ma?
examples.english: Outside the restroom at the MRT station there are many people lining up; do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 夏天的時候，食物不能在外面放太久。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, shíwù bù néng zài wàimiàn fàng tài jiǔ.
examples.english: In summer, food cannot be left outside for too long.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Ōu wèile shěng qián, zhěngge yuè dōu chī pàomiàn, zuìhòu chī huài le shēntǐ, chī yào, zhùyuàn huā le gèng duō qián.
examples.english: In order to save money, Xiao Ou ate instant noodles for a whole month; in the end, he ruined his health, and spent even more money on medicine and hospitalization.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.
examples.english: Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person.

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, rénmen xǐhuān zài wūzi wàimiàn chuī zhe fēng, hē zhe chá, liáoliao yǒuqù de shì.
examples.english: On summer nights, people like to be outside the house, feeling the breeze, drinking tea, and chatting about interesting things.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
examples.pinyin: Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.
examples.english: As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: A:怎麼回事？外面怎麼這麼吵？ B:鄰居在修理屋頂，快修理好了，你忍耐一下吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Zěnme huí shì? Wàimiàn zěnme zhème chǎo? B: Línjū zài xiūlǐ wūdǐng, kuài xiūlǐ hǎo le, nǐ rěnnài yīxià ba.
examples.english: A: What's the matter? Why is it so noisy outside? B: The neighbor is repairing the roof; it will be fixed soon, so please put up with it for a bit.

examples.chinese: 五年前經驗過護照被偷的意外後，每次出國我都把護照放在上衣裡面的口袋。
examples.pinyin: Wǔ nián qián jīngyàn guò hùzhào bèi tōu de yìwài hòu, měi cì chūguó wǒ dōu bǎ hùzhào fàng zài shàngyī lǐmiàn de kǒudài.
examples.english: After experiencing the accident of having my passport stolen five years ago, every time I go abroad, I put my passport in the pocket inside my jacket.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 有個騙子吃完了麵，假裝忘記帶錢包，騙老闆要回家拿錢，一離開就沒回來了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu ge piànzi chī wán le miàn, jiǎzhuāng wàngjì dài qiánbāo, piàn lǎobǎn yào huí jiā ná qián, yī líkāi jiù méi huílái le.
examples.english: A cheater finished eating noodles and pretended to have forgotten his wallet; he tricked the owner into letting him go home to get money, and as soon as he left, he never came back.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理表面上對老闆很客氣，其實心裡很不高興。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ biǎomiàn shàng duì lǎobǎn hěn kèqi, qíshí xīnlǐ hěn bù gāoxìng.
examples.english: During the meeting today, the manager was superficially very polite to the boss, but actually he was very unhappy inside.

examples.chinese: 小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ hǎojǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn, dōu bèi jùjué, suǒyǐ bù zài gēn tā liánluò le.
examples.english: Xiao Li asked his female online friend to meet several times but was rejected each time, so he no longer contacts her.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 林阿姨來我家推銷保險，我不好意思當面拒絕她，只好假裝有急事要出門。
examples.pinyin: Lín āyí lái wǒ jiā tuīxiāo bǎoxiǎn, wǒ bù hǎoyìsi dāngmiàn jùjué tā, zhǐhǎo jiǎzhuāng yǒu jíshì yào chūmén.
examples.english: Auntie Lin came to my house to sell insurance; I was too embarrassed to refuse her in person, so I had no choice but to pretend I had an urgent matter and had to go out.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。
examples.pinyin: A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.
examples.english: A: Hello, welcome to the interview. May I ask your honorable surname? B: Hello, my surname is Tong. I'm very happy to be able to come to your honorable company for an interview today.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, miànshì shí yào zhǔnbèi de xiāngguān wénjiàn bāokuò gèrén jīběn zīliào, bìyè zhèngshū děngděng.
examples.english: Generally speaking, the relevant documents to prepare for an interview include basic personal information, graduation certificate, and so on.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。
examples.pinyin: Nàge Měiguórén měitiān kàn Táiwān de liánxùjù, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn liǎojiě Táiwān de shēnghuó wénhuà.
examples.english: That American watches Taiwanese TV series every day: on one hand to learn Chinese, on the other hand to understand Taiwanese life and culture.

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 按照華人的習俗，紅包裡面的錢不可以是四百、四千等等。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Huárén de xísú, hóngbāo lǐmiàn de qián bù kěyǐ shì sìbǎi, sìqiān děngděng.
examples.english: According to Chinese customs, the money inside a red envelope cannot be 400, 4000, etc.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā gēn guójiā zhījiān de wàijiāo guānxì hěn zhòngyào, zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò shì zǒngtǒng fùzé de.
examples.english: Diplomatic relations between countries are very important; work in this area is the president's responsibility.

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 因為冰箱壞了，裡面的食物除了雞蛋、蘋果，其他的都腐敗了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi bīngxiāng huài le, lǐmiàn de shíwù chúle jīdàn, píngguǒ, qítā de dōu fǔbài le.
examples.english: Because the refrigerator broke, the food inside, except for the eggs and apples, all rotted.

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 中國南北方的飲食習慣有一些差異，南方人多吃米飯，北方人多吃餃子、饅頭等麵食。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó nánběifāng de yǐnshí xíguàn yǒu yīxiē chāyì, nánfāng rén duō chī mǐfàn, běifāng rén duō chī jiǎozi, mántou děng miànshí.
examples.english: There are some differences in eating habits between northern and southern China: southerners eat more cooked rice, while northerners eat more dumplings, steamed buns, and other wheat-based foods.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 沙發下面呢？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā xiàmiàn ne?
examples.english: How about checking under the sofa?

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。
examples.pinyin: A! Zài zhèlǐ! Qiánbāo zài wǒ de shū xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Ah! There it is! The wallet is under my book.

examples.chinese: 期中考快要到了，老師說我們可以去圖書館對面的大教室看書。
examples.pinyin: Qízhōngkǎo kuàiyào dào le, lǎoshī shuō wǒmen kěyǐ qù túshūguǎn duìmiàn de dà jiàoshì kànshū.
examples.english: The midterm exam is coming soon. The teacher said we could use the big classroom across from the library for studying.

items.wordHook: a 麥(wheat) rests on its 面(face) → pulled into 麵(noodles).

examples.chinese: 我要到他家去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào tā jiā qù.
examples.english: I want to go to his home.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上八點半到學校。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn bàn dào xuéxiào.
examples.english: I arrive at school at 8:30 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我後天要到這家飯店去看朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hòutiān yào dào zhè jiā fàndiàn qù kàn péngyǒu.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow I am going to this hotel to see a friend.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 我要坐飛機到英國去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zuò fēijī dào Yīngguó qù.
examples.english: I want to take an airplane to England.

examples.chinese: 我要到超級市場去買蛋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào chāojí shìchǎng qù mǎi dàn.
examples.english: I want to go to the supermarket to buy eggs.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上九點要到機場。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn yào dào jīchǎng.
examples.english: I need to arrive at the airport at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 我要到郵局去寄信，也要買一些信封。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào yóujú qù jì xìn, yě yào mǎi yīxiē xìnfēng.
examples.english: I want to go to the post office to mail a letter, and also buy some envelopes.

examples.chinese: 從我家到機場也不遠，開車去、坐捷運去都可以。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào jīchǎng yě bù yuǎn, kāichē qù, zuò jiéyùn qù dōu kěyǐ.
examples.english: It is not far from my house to the airport. I can go by car or MRT.

examples.chinese: 我常常在電視上看到那位有名的醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài diànshì shàng kàndào nà wèi yǒumíng de yīshēng.
examples.english: I often see that famous doctor on TV.

examples.chinese: 我們八點半開始上班，我每天都準時到公司。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bā diǎn bàn kāishǐ shàngbān, wǒ měi tiān dōu zhǔnshí dào gōngsī.
examples.english: We start work at 8:30; I arrive at the company on time every day.

examples.chinese: 他今天上班遲到了，老闆不太高興。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān shàngbān chídào le, lǎobǎn bú tài gāoxìng.
examples.english: He was late for work today; the boss is not too happy.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛在學校附近看到中明。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng zài xuéxiào fùjìn kàndào Zhōngmíng.
examples.english: I just now saw Zhongming near the school.

examples.chinese: 我往右看，看到了一間很漂亮的房子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǎng yòu kàn, kàndào le yì jiān hěn piàoliang de fángzi.
examples.english: I looked to the right and saw a very beautiful house.

examples.chinese: 你先往左轉，再往右轉，就到那家餐廳了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn, zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn, jiù dào nà jiā cāntīng le.
examples.english: First turn left, then turn right, and you'll arrive at that restaurant.

examples.chinese: 不好意思，我遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ chídào le.
examples.english: I'm sorry, I'm late.

examples.chinese: 我出了捷運站，就看到那家銀行了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chū le jiéyùn zhàn, jiù kàndào nà jiā yínháng le.
examples.english: As soon as I exited the MRT station, I saw that bank.

examples.chinese: 我們要過馬路，到對面去坐公車。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào guò mǎlù, dào duìmiàn qù zuò gōngchē.
examples.english: We need to cross the road to go to the opposite side to take the bus.

examples.chinese: 你往前走，過第二個十字路口，就到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, guò dì èr ge shízì lùkǒu, jiù dào le.
examples.english: Go straight ahead, pass the second intersection, and you'll arrive.

examples.chinese: 大家都歡迎新老師到我們學校來。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huānyíng xīn lǎoshī dào wǒmen xuéxiào lái.
examples.english: Everyone welcomes the new teacher to come to our school.

examples.chinese: 歡迎你們到我家來，請進。
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐmen dào wǒ jiā lái, qǐng jìn.
examples.english: Welcome to my home, please come in.

examples.chinese: 我們往前走，很快就到公園了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎng qián zǒu, hěn kuài jiù dào gōngyuán le.
examples.english: We walk forward, and we will soon arrive at the park.

examples.chinese: 從這裡往山上走，你就會看到很多牛。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng shān shàng zǒu, nǐ jiù huì kàndào hěn duō niú.
examples.english: If you walk up the mountain from here, you will see many cows.

examples.chinese: 我們上禮拜到山上去看日出了，好漂亮！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shàng lǐbài dào shān shàng qù kàn rìchū le, hǎo piàoliang!
examples.english: Last week we went up the mountain to see the sunrise; it was so beautiful!

examples.chinese: 從我家去捷運站，過一條街就到了，交通很方便。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā qù jiéyùn zhàn, guò yì tiáo jiē jiù dào le, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: From my home to the MRT station, cross one street and you're there; the transportation is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫是畢業以後到美國去工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shì bìyè yǐhòu dào Měiguó qù gōngzuò.
examples.english: His plan is to go to the United States to work after graduation.

examples.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
examples.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
examples.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

examples.chinese: 放假的時候，很多台灣人喜歡到東部去玩。
examples.pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhòu, hěn duō Táiwānrén xǐhuān dào dōngbù qù wán.
examples.english: During holidays, many Taiwanese people like to go to the eastern part (of Taiwan) for fun.

examples.chinese: 從中部坐車到南部去，差不多要兩個小時。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhōngbù zuò chē dào nánbù qù, chàbuduō yào liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Taking a bus from the central part to the southern part takes about two hours.

examples.chinese: 我們從小學到大學都是同學，也是很好的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng xiǎoxué dào dàxué dōu shì tóngxué, yě shì hěn hǎo de péngyǒu.
examples.english: From elementary school to university, we have always been classmates and also very good friends.

examples.chinese: 從昨天晚上到現在，已經下了十個小時的雨了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zuótiān wǎnshang dào xiànzài, yǐjīng xià le shí ge xiǎoshí de yǔ le.
examples.english: From last night until now, it has already rained for ten hours.

examples.chinese: 台灣從北到南有三百八十五公里。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān cóng běi dào nán yǒu sānbǎi bāshíwǔ gōnglǐ.
examples.english: Taiwan is 385 kilometers from north to south.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 小馬先用手機把要賣的商品全部都拍了下來，再放到網路上賣，一個星期就賣完了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ xiān yòng shǒujī bǎ yào mài de shāngpǐn quánbù dōu pāi le xiàlái, zài fàng dào wǎnglù shàng mài, yī ge xīngqī jiù mài wán le.
examples.english: Xiao Ma first used his cell phone to photograph all the products he wanted to sell, then put them online to sell, and they were sold out in a week.

examples.chinese: 東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english: Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七○年 （qīlíng niándài，1970∼1979） 非常有名的功夫明星。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le. Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.
examples.english: I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now. Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s.

examples.chinese: 想要得到好成績，除了努力用功，還得學習怎麼利用網路資源。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào dédào hǎo chéngjī, chúle nǔlì yònggōng, hái děi xuéxí zěnme lìyòng wǎnglù zīyuán.
examples.english: If you want to get good grades, besides working hard, you also need to learn how to use online resources.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐyù yòngpǐn de diàn, zhǐyào lái zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùndòng xié.
examples.english: This entire street is full of stores selling sports supplies; as long as you come here, you can buy the athletic shoes you want.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 爺爺去過阿里山好幾回，每次去都看到不同的風景，他說非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Yéye qù guò Ālǐshān hǎo jǐ huí, měi cì qù dōu kàn dào bùtóng de fēngjǐng, tā shuō fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Grandpa has been to Alishan several times; every time he goes, he sees different scenery, and he says it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.
examples.english: My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help.

examples.chinese: 昨天小康碰到一位好久不見的老朋友，他們聊天聊到很晚才回家。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān Xiǎo Kāng pèng dào yí wèi hǎojiǔ bú jiàn de lǎo péngyǒu, tāmen liáotiān liáo dào hěn wǎn cái huí jiā.
examples.english: Yesterday, Xiao Kang bumped into an old friend he hadn't seen for a long time; they chatted until very late before going home.

examples.chinese: 如果只注意別人的缺點，就永遠看不到他們的優點了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhùyì biérén de quēdiǎn, jiù yǒngyuǎn kàn bù dào tāmen de yōudiǎn le.
examples.english: If you only pay attention to others' shortcomings, you will never see their strengths.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 小文為了得到超商送的小禮物，每天都特地去那裡買咖啡、三明治。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎowén wèile dédào chāoshāng sòng de xiǎo lǐwù, měitiān dōu tèdì qù nàlǐ mǎi kāfēi, sānmíngzhì.
examples.english: In order to get the small gift from the convenience store, Xiaowen specially goes there every day to buy coffee and sandwiches.

examples.chinese: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store.

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 冬天一到，我的皮膚就變得很乾，所以得注意保養。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yí dào, wǒ de pífū jiù biàn de hěn gān, suǒyǐ děi zhùyì bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: As soon as winter arrives, my skin becomes very dry, so I have to pay attention to skincare.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.
examples.english: Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person.

examples.chinese: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin: Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english: Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
examples.english: My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì hěn jìnbù, wànyī mí le lù, jiù kěyǐ lìyòng wǎnglù dìtú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù.
examples.english: Technology is very advanced now; in case you get lost, you can use online maps to find the way home.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qīnyǎn kàndào Xiǎo Shǐ gēn rén chǎojià, cái zhīdào tā mà rén de yàngzi hǎo kěpà o!
examples.english: Yesterday I saw with my own eyes Xiao Shi arguing with someone, and only then did I realize how scary he looks when he scolds people!

examples.chinese: 臺灣人在國外碰到問題時，可以立刻打0800-085-095「你幫我，你救我」這支電話求救。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rén zài guówài pèngdào wèntí shí, kěyǐ lìkè dǎ 0800-085-095 “nǐ bāng wǒ, nǐ jiù wǒ” zhè zhī diànhuà qiújiù.
examples.english: When Taiwanese people encounter problems abroad, they can immediately call 0800-085-095, the “you help me, you save me” number, to ask for help.

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 夏天一到，這個海灘上就會看到許多人帶著衝浪板來衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yī dào, zhège hǎitān shàng jiù huì kàndào xǔduō rén dàizhe chōnglàngbǎn lái chōnglàng.
examples.english: As soon as summer arrives, you will see many people bringing surfboards to surf at this beach.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 剛才我正想給英英打電話時，沒想到她就先打來了。
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ zhèng xiǎng gěi Yīngying dǎ diànhuà shí, méi xiǎngdào tā jiù xiān dǎ lái le.
examples.english: Just now, when I was right about to call Yingying, I didn't expect that she would call first.

examples.chinese: 有一些父母不讓孩子去夜店，主要是因為聽說那裡有人吸毒，也買得到毒品。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē fùmǔ bù ràng háizi qù yèdiàn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu rén xīdú, yě mǎi de dào dúpǐn.
examples.english: Some parents don't let their children go to nightclubs, mainly because they've heard that people take drugs there and that drugs can be bought there.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 大龍最近買了一套音響，每天回到家就聽他最愛的英國樂團的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Dàlóng zuìjìn mǎi le yī tào yīnxiǎng, měitiān huí dào jiā jiù tīng tā zuì ài de Yīngguó yuètuán de yīnyuè.
examples.english: Dalong recently bought a stereo set; every day when he gets home, he listens to music by his favorite British band.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 小李進公司的頭三個月，每天上班要花兩個小時，後來搬到公司附近，走路十分鐘就到了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jìn gōngsī de tóu sān ge yuè, měi tiān shàngbān yào huā liǎng ge xiǎoshí, hòulái bān dào gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: For the first three months after Xiao Li joined the company, it took him two hours to commute every day; later he moved near the company, and it took only ten minutes to walk there.

examples.chinese: 我們爬山爬到一半就起風了，過了幾分鐘就下起大雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen páshān pá dào yíbàn jiù qǐ fēng le, guò le jǐ fēnzhōng jiù xià qǐ dà yǔ lái le.
examples.english: We were halfway up the mountain when the wind started to rise, and a few minutes later it started to rain heavily.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 為了偏僻地區孩子的教育，有十幾位老師願意上山下海，到山上、海邊的學校教書。
examples.pinyin: Wèile piānpì dìqū háizi de jiàoyù, yǒu shí jǐ wèi lǎoshī yuànyì shàngshānxiàhǎi, dào shānshàng, hǎibiān de xuéxiào jiāoshū.
examples.english: For the education of children in remote areas, more than ten teachers are willing to go everywhere, to schools in the mountains and by the sea, to teach.

examples.chinese: 我到德國留學的頭兩個星期，因為對環境不環境而迷過幾次路，後來就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào Déguó liúxué de tóu liǎng gè xīngqī, yīnwèi duì huánjìng bù shúxī ér mí guò jǐ cì lù, hòulái jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: In the first two weeks of studying in Germany, because I was not familiar with the environment, I got lost a few times; later there was no problem.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ ge rén dōu kàndào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒzāi yǒuguān, tā búdàn bù chéngrèn, fǎn'ér shuō shì línjū zuò de.
examples.english: Several people saw that he was connected to this fire; not only did he not admit it, but instead he said the neighbor did it.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu búdàn zhīshi hěn fēngfù, yánjiū chéngguǒ yě shòudào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Professor Wang not only has abundant knowledge, but his research results are also recognized by everyone.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 李先生經常咳嗽，可是他完全不在意。直到今天咳得說不出話來了，才肯去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng jīngcháng késòu, kěshì tā wánquán bù zàiyì. Zhídào jīntiān ké de shuō bù chū huà lái le, cái kěn qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: Mr. Li often coughs, but he doesn't care at all. It was not until today, when he coughed so much that he couldn't speak, that he was willing to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 陳先生身體一向挺健康的，沒想到一個小感冒就讓他病了一個多月。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng shēntǐ yīxiàng tǐng jiànkāng de, méi xiǎngdào yī gè xiǎo gǎnmào jiù ràng tā bìng le yī gè duō yuè.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has always been quite healthy; I never expected that a small cold would make him fall ill for over a month.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese: 報名衝浪課的手續很簡單，只要到辦公室填一張基本資料表就行了。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng chōnglàng kè de shǒuxù hěn jiǎndān, zhǐyào dào bàngōngshì tián yī zhāng jīběn zīliào biǎo jiù xíng le.
examples.english: The procedure for registering for the surfing class is very simple; you just need to go to the office and fill out one basic information form.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有夢想，只要不怕挑戰、堅持到底，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu mèngxiǎng, zhǐyào bú pà tiǎozhàn, jiānchí dàodǐ, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: Everyone has dreams; as long as you are not afraid of challenges and persist to the end, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 購物時，最好要貨比三家，才能買到品質較佳、價格較合理的商品。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí, zuìhǎo yào huò bǐ sān jiā, cái néng mǎi dào pǐnzhì jiào jiā, jiàgé jiào hélǐ de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: When shopping, it is best to compare goods at three stores; only then can you buy products with relatively better quality and relatively more reasonable prices.

examples.chinese: 章先生念國小時，父親帶著他上山下海、到處旅遊，那是屬於他們的美好記憶。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng niàn guóxiǎo shí, fùqīn dàizhe tā shàngshān xiàhǎi, dàochù lǚyóu, nà shì shǔyú tāmen de měihǎo jìyì.
examples.english: When Mr. Zhang was in elementary school, his father took him up mountains and across seas, traveling everywhere; that is a beautiful memory belonging to them.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 金先生最近遇到了很不幸的事，他的父母在一場交通意外中去世了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiānsheng zuìjìn yùdàole hěn búxìng de shì, tā de fùmǔ zài yì chǎng jiāotōng yìwài zhōng qùshì le.
examples.english: Mr. Jin recently encountered a very unfortunate event: his parents died in a traffic accident.

examples.chinese: 王小姐用網路交友的方式，找到了理想的結婚對象。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě yòng wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì, zhǎodàole lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng.
examples.english: Miss Wang used the method of making friends online and found her ideal marriage partner.

examples.chinese: 透過教授的介紹，我一畢業就順利地找到了滿意的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò jiàoshòu de jièshào, wǒ yī bìyè jiù shùnlì de zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Through the professor's introduction, I smoothly found a satisfactory job as soon as I graduated.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 他透過網路認識了一位網友，直到結婚前，他們才見過對方三次。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò wǎnglù rènshi le yī wèi wǎngyǒu, zhídào jiéhūn qián, tāmen cái jiàn guò duìfāng sān cì.
examples.english: He met an online friend through the Internet, and they had only seen each other three times before they got married.

examples.chinese: A:好久沒看到你父母了，請替我問候他們。 B:沒問題。
examples.pinyin: A: Hǎojiǔ méi kàndào nǐ fùmǔ le, qǐng tì wǒ wènhòu tāmen. B: Méi wèntí.
examples.english: A: I haven't seen your parents for a long time; please give them my regards. B: No problem.

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 我是金東賢的戲迷，今天終於看到他本人，實在太開心了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Jīn Dōngxián de xìmí, jīntiān zhōngyú kàndào tā běnrén, shízài tài kāixīn le.
examples.english: I am a fan of Kim Dong-hyun; today I finally saw him in person, and I am really so happy.

examples.chinese: 當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ yùdào cuòzhé shí, tā zǒngshì xiézhù wǒ kèfú kùnnán, wǒmen zhījiān yě jiànlì le zhēnguì de yǒuyì.
examples.english: When I encounter setbacks, he always helps me overcome difficulties, and we have also established a precious friendship between us.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。
examples.pinyin: Mǒu nián mǒu yuè de mǒu yī tiān, nǐ huì zhǎodào xīnzhōng zuì lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng, xiànzài bié jí.
examples.english: On a certain day of a certain month in a certain year, you will find the most ideal marriage partner in your heart; don't rush now.

examples.chinese: 我知道那輛德國汽車很貴，至於到底多貴，我就不清楚了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nà liàng Déguó qìchē hěn guì, zhìyú dàodǐ duō guì, wǒ jiù bù qīngchu le.
examples.english: I know that German car is very expensive; as to exactly how expensive, I'm not clear.

examples.chinese: A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。
examples.pinyin: A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.
examples.english: A: Hello, welcome to the interview. May I ask your honorable surname? B: Hello, my surname is Tong. I'm very happy to be able to come to your honorable company for an interview today.

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.
examples.english: Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me.

examples.chinese: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen.

examples.chinese: 李導演付出了十年的時間，終於拍出了一部好電影，得到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn fùchū le shí nián de shíjiān, zhōngyú pāichū le yī bù hǎo diànyǐng, dédào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Director Li devoted ten years of time and finally made a good movie, receiving everyone's recognition.

examples.chinese: 小張已經四十歲了，父母盼望他快點找到結婚對象，他卻一點也不著急。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎozhāng yǐjīng sìshí suì le, fùmǔ pànwàng tā kuài diǎn zhǎodào jiéhūn duìxiàng, tā què yīdiǎn yě bù zháojí.
examples.english: Xiaozhang is already forty years old; his parents yearn for him to quickly find a marriage partner, but he is not anxious at all.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ jiàoshòu wèi le ràng gèng duō rén liǎojiě bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng yǒu duō zhòngyào, jīngcháng dào gèdì qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to let more people understand how important it is to protect the Earth's environment, Professor Shi often goes to various places to give speeches.

examples.chinese: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn jīntiān yùdào yǐqián de nǚpéngyǒu, gēn tā hē le kāfēi cái huí jiā, dàn bù gǎn gēn tàitai shuō shíhuà.
examples.english: Today Xiao Jian ran into his ex-girlfriend, and only went home after having coffee with her, but he didn't dare tell his wife the truth.

examples.chinese: 這本中文教材是網路書店出版的，你得上網才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zhōngwén jiàocái shì wǎnglù shūdiàn chūbǎn de, nǐ děi shàngwǎng cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: This Chinese textbook is published by an online bookstore; you have to go online to be able to buy it.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Āyí de hūnlǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiàotáng jǔxíng, zhège zhòngyào shíkè wǒ yīdìng bùnéng chídào.
examples.english: Auntie's wedding will be held at the church at two o'clock tomorrow afternoon; I absolutely must not be late for this important moment.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài Chúxī nà tiān, dōu yào huídào fùmǔ shēnbiān, quánjiā jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people all return to their parents' side, and the whole family gathers together to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuādào xiǎotōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dàidào jǐngchájú, guān le qǐlái.
examples.english: After the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu. Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together. Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.
examples.english: When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo tòuguò wǎnglù, bàozhǐ, xúnzhǎo sānshí nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér fēnkāi de jiārén, zuìhòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le.
examples.english: Uncle Lin searched through the Internet and newspapers for family members separated thirty years ago because of war, and finally found them.

examples.chinese: 到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。
examples.pinyin: Dào dìzhèn zāiqū jiùzāi de jūnrénmen, zhè jǐ tiān máng de lián yí dùn fàn dōu méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo de chī.
examples.english: The soldiers who went to the earthquake disaster area for rescue have been so busy these days that they couldn't even properly eat a single meal.

examples.chinese: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.
examples.english: Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 王伯伯最近很得意，到處告訴鄰居他兒子考上了全國最有名的大學。
examples.pinyin: Wáng bóbo zuìjìn hěn déyì, dàochù gàosù línjū tā érzi kǎo shàng le quánguó zuì yǒumíng de dàxué.
examples.english: Uncle Wang has been very proud of himself recently, telling neighbors everywhere that his son has been admitted to the most famous university in the country.

examples.chinese: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
examples.pinyin: Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.
examples.english: The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 可是從四點到五點半我要上英文課，六點去，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì cóng sì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn bàn wǒ yào shàng Yīngwén kè, liù diǎn qù, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: But I have an English class from 4 to 5:30 p.m. How about 6 p.m.?

examples.chinese: 期中考快要到了，老師說我們可以去圖書館對面的大教室看書。
examples.pinyin: Qízhōngkǎo kuàiyào dào le, lǎoshī shuō wǒmen kěyǐ qù túshūguǎn duìmiàn de dà jiàoshì kànshū.
examples.english: The midterm exam is coming soon. The teacher said we could use the big classroom across from the library for studying.
